text:
ana: Quick check — proposal to trim rollout metadata. Idea: keep only `release_id`, `model_ref`, `compat_version`, and a short `policy` blob. Drop `lease_owner`, `affinity_score`, `originator_meta` unless explicitly requested. Rationale: reduces telemetry cardinality and network size for small requests. Thoughts? :thinking:

jay: Concern: clients may depend on `lease_owner` for routing. We need a migration shim. Could we keep it behind a feature flag for 3 months?

mikhail: Agree migration shim. Also propose we emit `compat_version` as semver-ish string and add `compat_matrix_url` for heavy clients to fetch mapping. Minimal payload stays lightweight but clients can opt-in for more info.

kim: Ops note — storage & query cost drops if we remove high-cardinality fields. But we must preserve an immutable `release_id` for audits. Suggest rolling schema v1 -> v2 with a deprecation header: `X-Rollout-Meta-Version: 2`.

ana (typo fix): sorry, meant ana — +1 on release_id and header. For clients that need `lease_owner` during rollout, can we expose it via `GET /rollout/:id/expanded` with auth? That keeps write path small.

jay: That works. Also add telemetry metric `rollout.meta.expanded_fetch_count` so we can measure adoption before full removal.

mikhail: Implementation detail: server-side default for `policy` should be `{ "fallback": ["small", "medium"], "max_age_s": 3600 }`. I'll paste the proto snippet:

```
message RolloutMetaV2 {
  string release_id = 1;
  string model_ref = 2;
  string compat_version = 3; // e.g. "2025.10"
  string policy_json = 4; // short JSON blob for routing/fallbacks
}
```

kim: Nice. Ops/PG question: how will we backfill old rows? Backfill will be expensive; propose a lazy backfill: convert on-read and emit migration events.

deploy-bot: deploy created for branch `meta-minimize` — staging rollout in progress :rocket:

ana: Action items: 1) mikhail to add proto + server defaults (ETA 2d). 2) kim to add telemetry + header support (ETA 3d). 3) jay to draft client shim plan & opt-in endpoint (ETA EOD). We'll reconvene after staging. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
